description: This file declares the ServerLoopImpl class, which implements the ServerLoop interface and related features for managing server operations in the run_cvd component of the Cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations for starting, suspending, resuming, and snapshotting virtual machines, as well as handling various server actions and configurations.
